**csv2psql** is a project in [Tools](@/projects/tools.md). Its code is written mainly in [Ruby](@/glossary/ruby.md) (98.4 %), with [HTML](@/glossary/html.md).

The [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) was created on 31 August 2014; its latest [commit](@/glossary/commit.md) is from 6 November 2015. It reads “Bump version to 0.0.19”. With no commit in the last 48 months it is listed as archive: work from 2014–2015, kept for the record and dated as measured.

It is built with [PostgreSQL](@/glossary/postgresql.md).

It runs as a live site on [GitHub Pages](@/glossary/github-pages.md): <https://korczis.github.io/csv2psql/>.

Its source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/korczis/csv2psql) and [GitLab](https://gitlab.com/korczis/csv2psql).

Related work in [Tools](@/projects/tools.md): [json2csv](@/work/json2csv.md) (2014–2015), [grache](@/work/grache.md) (2015), [codecademy](@/work/codecademy.md) (2014) and [mapoffacts](@/work/mapoffacts.md) (2017).
